memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "And they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God among the trees of the garden." — Genesis 3:8

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The first question God ever asked humanity was not because He had lost His way or was missing information. Rather, it was asked because man was lost. "Adam, where are you?" was the heart-cry of a Father’s love, searching for His child who had retreated into the shadows. Adam attempted to hide his nakedness behind fig leaves and trees, offering answers that were not honest confessions, but childish excuses.
​Since that day in Eden, humanity has continued to build walls of sin, mistakenly believing they can live hidden from the Almighty. But God, in His infinite mercy, did not abandon us to the siege of sin we created for ourselves. He sent His only begotten Son, Jesus Christ, to shatter the walls of spiritual bondage and deliver us from our vain hideouts.
​Today, in this Season of Grace, a significant shift has occurred. In Eden, God sought man; now, man is invited to seek God. Many stand behind their own barriers asking, "Where is God?" The truth is, He is not far off; He is as close to you as your own shadow. When a person abandons the habit of hiding and begins to seek God with true repentance, they find "Divine Liberation." Through the greatness of forgiveness, that search ends in a joyful reunion where man is once again united with God.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "A sigh for fellowship with God arising from the human heart, when turned into prayer, is what allows us to find Him." — Unknown

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, I thank You that even when I was hiding in the darkness of my own sin, You never stopped looking for me. Forgive me for the times I wandered away through vanity and excuses. Today, I step out of my hiding places and seek Your presence with my whole heart. Thank You for the deliverance found in Jesus Christ and for the grace that allows me to find You right now. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Stop running from the One who loves you most. Your hiding places are far too small for your soul; come out and rejoice in the abundant light of His forgiveness. He is not waiting to punish you; He is standing with open arms, waiting to welcome you home.
